identificationModule.briefTitle: Aprepitant Injectable Emulsion in Patients With COVID-19 (GUARDS-1)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 2 Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Study of Aprepitant Injectable Emulsion in Early Hospitalized Adult Patients With COVID-19

statusModule.whyStopped: Study was terminated early by Heron, and was not terminated for safety reasons.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The study will evaluate the efficacy and safety of aprepitant injectable emulsion added to standard of care for hospitalized patients with COVID-19.

interventions.name: Aprepitant injectable emulsion
interventions.description: Aprepitant injectable emulsion, once daily (QD) for 14 days.

interventions.name: Saline Placebo
interventions.description: Saline Placebo, once daily (QD) for 14 days.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of Subjects Alive and Discharged From the Hospital.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Time to Death or Respiratory Failure, Defined as Any of the Following: Endotracheal Intubation and Mechanical Ventilation; Oxygen Delivered by High-flow Nasal Cannula; Noninvasive Positive Pressure Ventilation; Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation (ECMO).

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Days 7, 14, 28, Discharge (from 2 to 43 days; median 6 days (Aprepitant), 8 days (Placebo))

secondaryOutcomes.description: Number of subjects reporting at least on Treatment-Emergent Adverse Event. Subjects reporting more than one event are counted only once using the highest severity.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Is hospitalized for ≤48 hours with SARS-CoV-2 infection. Confirmed by polymerase chain reaction (PCR), antigen or immunoglobulin M (IgM) antibody test.
* Has at least 1 of the following: Radiographic infiltrates by imaging, or oxygen saturation of \<94% by pulse oximetry on room air or requiring supplemental oxygen.
* Not anticipated to require mechanical ventilation within 48 hours.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Is taking high-dose hydroxychloroquine or chloroquine.
* Is taking pimozide or strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors.
* Is currently receiving treatment with products intended to modify immune response to COVID-19 (exception: dexamethasone, methylprednisolone, or equivalent are allowed), chemotherapy or on hemodialysis or peritoneal dialysis.
* Has known hypersensitivity to any components of aprepitant injectable emulsion.
* Has evidence of ARDS.
* Is being treated with oxygen delivered by high-flow nasal cannula nonrebreather mask, noninvasive positive pressure ventilation, or ECMO.
* Has multiple organ failure.
* Has current confirmed Influenza A or B infection, or a a history of organ or hematologic transplant, HIV, or active hepatitis B or hepatitis C infection.
